rows.title: Signed skills
rows.basis: skill_versions, skill_installs, skill_trust_records; existing skills verification/install/revoke owner

rows.title: Slack adapter
rows.basis: ingress_events, delivery_outbox; channel bindings reference opaque credential handles

rows.title: MCP protocol adapter
rows.basis: existing MCP adapter and identity/effect owners; no new tool execution authority

rows.title: A2A protocol adapter
rows.basis: existing A2A remote task state and effect journal; trusted tenant and remote identity bindings

rows.title: Fleet WhatsApp Discord
rows.basis: agent assignments referencing canonical tasks, deliveries, grants and budgets

rows.title: Production restore retention release
rows.basis: backup/restore/retention reports linked to artifact digests; not a second live database

rows.title: Shadow tool synthesis
rows.basis: immutable tool manifests and held-out evaluation references; no automatic promotion

rows.title: Optional observations and exchange
rows.basis: observations, observation_revisions, observation_exchange; existing SQL is not proof of qualification

rows.title: Guarded scaffold evolution
rows.basis: versioned candidate digest, evaluation and explicit release references

rows.title: Full conformance and handoff
rows.basis: read-only aggregation of owner qualification evidence; no domain CRUD table

rows.title: Autonomous Task Decomposition
rows.contractShape: TaskPlan/PlanStep/PlanValidation/StepOutcome use section 5. Canonical planDigest binds goalRevision and ordered validated steps; scheduler accepts only completed predecessor outcomes and never treats unknown as completed.
rows.acceptance: Reject cycles, bound fan-out, enforce dependencies/cancellation/parent budget; no duplicate effects

rows.title: Agent Self-Reflection + Critic
rows.contractShape: CritiqueReport: reportId, goalId, goalRevision, taskResultRef, criticId/version, findings[{claimId, category(unsupported/conflict/error/missing_evidence), evidenceRefs, safeSummary}], suggestedPlanRevision?, usage. At most 32 findings and 2 critique rounds per interactive run within inherited iteration/task caps.
rows.acceptance: Critic catches seeded errors; all inference routed; bounded critique cannot grant effect permission

rows.title: Agent Skill Marketplace
rows.contractShape: SkillInstallRequest: skillId, version, publisherId, manifestDigest, requestedCapabilityRefs, catalogEntryRef, expectedCatalogRevision. SkillInstallProposal: proposalId, same immutable digest, policyDecisionRef, reviewState(pending/approved/rejected), evalReportRef?, revocationState. Catalog results bound 1–100 entries, authenticated pagination; no executable marketplace payload.
rows.acceptance: Verify digest/signature/provenance, permissions, revocation and evaluation; signature never substitutes for isolation

rows.title: Dynamic Skill Loading
rows.contractShape: SkillSelectionRequest: taskType, availableSkillRefs, requestedSkillRefs, maxContextTokens, grantRef. QualifiedSkillSelection: sorted skillId/version/digest refs, selectedInstructionRefs, omitted reasons, tokenCount. Selection filters verified/nonrevoked/authorized skills before deterministic ranking; instructions remain distinct from untrusted data.
rows.acceptance: Deterministic selection, bounded context, declared capability checks; no unsigned script import

rows.title: Agent Factory
rows.contractShape: AgentDefinitionCandidate: definitionId, roleId, promptArtifactDigest, modelPolicyRef, skillVersionRefs, toolManifestRefs, requestedCapabilityRefs, memoryPolicyRef, evalSetRef. AgentDefinitionProposal: proposalId, candidateDigest, evalReportRef, policyDecisionRef, lifecycle(staged/denied/review_required), versionRef. Never deploy or issue authority on definition validation alone.
rows.acceptance: Human/policy-controlled provisioning, identity isolation, signed version and evaluation; creation cannot expand authority

rows.title: Persistent Agents
rows.contractShape: AgentLifecycleResult: agentId, definitionVersionRef, checkpointRef?, owningRunId?, lifecycle(active/suspended/stopped/revoked/failed), lastTransitionAt, currentGrantRef?, nextScheduleRef?. Persistent agents resume only with current authorization; stop revokes future dispatch and cancels bounded active work.
rows.acceptance: Recover checkpoints after restart, expire grants, stop on revoke, and enforce per-run/background limits

rows.title: Event-Driven Agents
rows.contractShape: TriggerEvent: schemaVersion, eventId, tenantId (derived by trusted adapter), sourceId, externalEventId, occurredAt, receivedAt, bounded payloadRef, signatureVerificationRef. TriggerAcceptance: acceptedId, duplicate boolean, scheduledRunRef?, status(accepted/rejected/rate_limited). Idempotency keys bind tenant/source/externalEventId and validated digest.
rows.acceptance: Verify signatures, deduplicate, reject forged tenant/events, rate-limit storms; no silent new queue

rows.title: Agent Scheduling
rows.contractShape: ScheduleSpec: scheduleId, tenantId, owningConversationId, goalRef, timezone(IANA), scheduleExpression, missedRunPolicy(skip/run_once), overlapPolicy(skip/queue_one), notificationIntent, version, budgetRef, grantRef. ScheduleRecord adds nextRunAt, lastRunRef?, enabled, policyDecisionRef. DST gaps/overlaps, deletion and downtime have explicit deterministic fixtures; no arbitrary code in expressions.
rows.acceptance: Test missed/duplicate schedules and timezone handling; notify only according to configured intent

rows.title: Human Approval Gates
rows.contractShape: ApprovalQuorumRequest: effectRef/inputHash/artifactHash?, policyVersion, proposalVersion, requiredActorRoles, quorumCount, expiresAt, nonceRef. ApprovalQuorumDecision: pending/allowed/denied/expired plus authenticated decisionRefs, exact binding and current epoch. Modification creates a new proposal/version; no client-provided replacement effect args.
rows.acceptance: Bind exact hashes/version/expiry/nonce; modification invalidates approval; no stale/double-use approval

rows.title: Agent Permission Tokens
rows.contractShape: ResourceGrantRequest: requested action/resource/audience constraints, expiry, parentGrantRef, delegationDepth. Signed grants bind verified parent lineage, tenant, audience, action and resource selectors; deny unknown/revoked parents, widened selectors and expiry beyond parent. Opaque signing keys remain in identity service.
rows.acceptance: Reject wrong audience, expired/revoked grants and privilege escalation; no raw account secret in payload

rows.title: Action Preview / Simulation Mode
rows.contractShape: ActionPreview: previewId, effectId, inputHash, artifactHash?, simulationReportRef, assumptions, proposedChangesRef, estimatedCostMicroUsd|null, risks, expiresAt, version. Preview uses no-live-effect grants; later execution revalidates current authority and exact reviewed digest.
rows.acceptance: Preview has no live writes; display assumptions; execute only the approved artifact/input

rows.title: Rollback Agent
rows.contractShape: CompensationPlan: planId, originalReceiptRef, observedStateRef, supportedActionRefs, irreversibleOutcomes, requiredApprovalRef, expectedStateDigest, boundedDeadline. Every compensation is a new authorized journaled effect; plan cannot promise universal rollback or undo unknown external outcomes automatically.
rows.acceptance: Demonstrate recovery for supported operations; identify irreversible outcomes; compensate only under current authority

rows.title: Self-Healing Agents
rows.contractShape: RecoveryInput: failedTaskRef, normalizedError, receiptRef?, currentPlanRef, attemptsAlreadyUsed. RecoveryPlan: retry/reconcile/replan/stop, reasonCode, approvedAlternativeRefs, nextPlanRevision?, maxRemainingAttempts. Unknown external effects select reconcile; retry cap includes previous attempts and excludes forbidden provider fallback.
rows.acceptance: Bound retries; reconcile unknown effects; preserve privacy/authority; alternative route cannot relax restrictions

rows.title: Agent Reputation System
rows.contractShape: WorkerScore: workerId, metricVersion, sampleCount, quality/latency/cost/violation aggregates, evidenceRefs, measuredAt, validUntil. RankedWorker: workerId, eligibility, scoreBasis, deterministicRank. Eligibility (health/current grants/capacity/policy) precedes scoring; stale/poisoned samples cannot elevate unsafe workers.
rows.acceptance: Use measured/versioned samples; prevent metric poisoning and unsafe-worker selection; deterministic tie-breaks

rows.title: Agent Competition
rows.contractShape: CandidateComparisonRequest: goalRef, planRef, candidateRefs(2–4), evaluatorVersionRef, budgetRef, noLiveWrites=true. CandidateComparison: winnerRef|null, criterionResults, disagreementSummary, evidenceRefs, usage. Each candidate isolated; judge cannot authorize execution or exceed shared budget.
rows.acceptance: Shared budget; isolated candidates; no duplicate live writes; judge claims require evidence

rows.title: Multi-agent Debate
rows.contractShape: DebateRequest: proposalArtifactRef, roleRefs(2–4), maxRounds(1–2), successCriteriaRefs, budgetRef. DebateReport: proposalVersionRef, bounded contributions/evidenceRefs, disagreements, recommendations, usage. Two-round debate remains within inherited 8 delegated-task and 12 model-iteration caps.
rows.acceptance: Bound turns; preserve disagreement/provenance; evidence decides acceptance; no policy changes by debate

rows.title: Agent Economy / Budget Manager
rows.contractShape: BudgetAllocationRequest: budgetRef, proposedWorkRefs, observedCostRefs, expectedVersion. BudgetAllocationPlan: version, allocations[{workRef,reservedTokens,reservedCostMicroUsd}], unknownUsageRefs, totalReserved. Reservation remains authoritative atomic budget service; optimization cannot exceed approved parent/tenant quotas.
rows.acceptance: Concurrent reservations cannot overspend; reconcile unknown usage; all child spend accounted for

rows.title: Context Compiler
rows.contractShape: ContextCompileRequest: permittedSourceRefs, goalRef?, taskType, maxContextTokens, stablePrefixRef, requiredToolGroupRefs. ContextBundle: ordered sourceRefs, compiledArtifactRef, prefixHash, tokenCount, omittedRefs/reasons, trustLabels. Preserve complete tool groups and inherited compression thresholds; measure retained-evidence recall.
rows.acceptance: Stable prefix and tool groups survive compression; no unauthorized content; measure recall/token impact

rows.title: Memory Confidence + Memory Expiration
rows.contractShape: MemoryLifecycleRevision: memoryId, expectedMemoryVersion, sourceRefs, confidenceBasis, createdAt, verifiedAt?, expiresAt?, contradictionRefs, proposedValueRef?. Existing numeric confidence is preserved with a declared basis. Lifecycle metadata and value revisions use broker authorization/CAS; expired facts cannot outrank verified corrections.
rows.acceptance: Expired/conflicting facts cannot silently outrank verified corrections; preserve provenance/scope

rows.title: Knowledge Graph Memory
rows.contractShape: GraphQuery: permitted scope refs, entityRefs, relationTypes, maxDepth(1–2), limit(1–100), cursor?. GraphResult: scoped observations/relations with sourceRefs, validUntil, revisions, nextCursor. Every traversal hop is tenant/role/private filtered inside existing PostgreSQL observation broker; no new graph database.
rows.acceptance: Apply tenant/role/private checks to graph traversal too; retain relation sources; no new graph DB without ADR

rows.title: Memory Branches
rows.contractShape: MemoryBranchQuery: branchId, requestedScopeRefs, queryRef, expectedBranchVersion, limit(1–100). MemoryBranchResult: authorized branch ancestry, matching memoryRefs, versions, nextCursor?. Branch metadata defines parent/expiry/grants; inheritance never widens audience or copies Private facts into Global.
rows.acceptance: Explicit branch grants/inheritance; no wider-scope copy; temporary expiry verified

rows.title: Secret Memory
rows.contractShape: CredentialHandleRequest: opaque handleId, verified effectRef, requiredAction/resource/audience, expiry and RunContext. CredentialResolution: opaque executionBindingRef, expiry, allowedTargetDigest. Resolution stays within trusted broker/executor; provider/DB/signing plaintext never reaches model, specialist task, UI or semantic memory.
rows.acceptance: Raw credentials absent from model/payload/browser/logs; expiry/revoke works; broker authority tested

rows.title: Long-running Projects
rows.contractShape: ProjectRecord uses section 5. Restart preserves goal/plan/artifact/blocker refs and current revisions. Completion derives from required verified goals; renewed grants and per-run/project budget govern every resumed operation.
rows.acceptance: Resume safely after restart; show evidence-derived progress; re-authorize new effects and enforce project budget

rows.title: Agent Workspace
rows.contractShape: WorkspaceRequest: workspaceId, agentDefinitionRef, assignedPathRefs, readOnlyMountRefs, allowedDomains, byteQuota, expiresAt, retentionPolicyRef. WorkspaceLease: leaseId, opaque rootRef, validated mount/network profileDigest, expiry, cleanupState. Canonical path and symlink checks prevent escaping assigned roots.
rows.acceptance: Restrict paths/mounts, prevent cross-agent leakage, define retention/cleanup; no host-global filesystem authority

rows.title: Artifact-first agents
rows.contractShape: ArtifactCandidate: artifactId, tenantId, owningConversationId/runId, mediaType, byteSize, contentRef, sha256, producerVersionRef, sourceEvidenceRefs, validationReportRef, visibilityScope. ArtifactReference remains the existing compatible reference; safe metadata supplies provenance. Publication/export is a separate authorized effect.
rows.acceptance: Artifact exists, validates/renders appropriately, has provenance/digest/access controls; publication separately authorized

rows.title: Browser / Computer Agent
rows.contractShape: BrowserTask: taskId, goalRef, startingUrl, allowedDomainRefs, sessionProfileRef, permittedActionRefs, upload/downloadRefs, approvalRefs, deadline. Sensitive form submissions require exact policy approval; domain/redirect/file checks apply at execution; returns existing TaskResult evidence and artifacts.
rows.acceptance: Isolated session, domain/file allowlists, injection-resistant authority boundary, exact approval for sensitive submissions

rows.title: Data Analyst Agent
rows.contractShape: DataTask: taskId, goalRef, connectionHandleRef, permittedSchemaRefs, queryArtifactRef, readOnly=true by default, row/byte/time limits, analysisCriteriaRefs. SQL parser/resource policy, real database runtime role and read limits precede execution. Output includes reproducible arithmetic and source/result digests; writes require a separate reviewed effect.
rows.acceptance: Read limits and SQL/resource validation; correct arithmetic; uncertainty and causal limits visible

rows.title: Coding Agent with full software lifecycle
rows.contractShape: CodingTask: taskId, goalRef, repositoryRef, baseCommit, assignedPaths, allowedCommands, branchRef, acceptanceTestRefs, reviewPolicyRef. Branch/test/diff/PR stages are separate effects; no merge/deploy authority implied. Required independent review and scans attach evidence to existing TaskResult.
rows.acceptance: Assigned files, appropriate checks and separate review; no merge/deploy without authority; preserve protected boundaries

rows.title: Research Agent with Research Graph
rows.contractShape: ResearchTask: taskId, goalRef, question, hypothesisRefs, permittedSourceRefs, maxQueries, claimCriteriaRefs, graphMode(disabled/scoped). Results use EvidenceClaim and VerificationReport, source timestamps, contradiction/unknown states. Persistent graph requires original 28 qualification; ordinary research does not silently enable it.
rows.acceptance: Link claims to sources/observed dates; show conflict and unknowns; confidence must have a declared basis

rows.title: Security Agent
rows.contractShape: SecuritySignalBatch: tenantId, bounded metadata signalRefs(1–100), windowStart/end, detectorVersion. SecurityAlert: alertId, severity, observedAt, evidenceRefs, detectorVersion, signedReceiptRef, safeRecommendation. Monitor can observe/report only; it cannot grant permissions or edit protected policy.
rows.acceptance: Detect seeded threats using safe metadata; signed alerts; monitor cannot rewrite policy or grant itself access

rows.title: Prompt Injection Firewall
rows.contractShape: UntrustedInput: inputRef, origin(web/tool/memory/episode/skill/remote), observedDigest, bounded contentRef. TrustLabelledInput: same refs/digest, instructionTrust(untrusted_data), flags, quarantineRef?. Detection false negatives never promote content to authorization; content cannot alter policy or credential scope.
rows.acceptance: Adversarial content cannot authorize effects; detector misses do not grant credentials or bypass policy

rows.title: AI Decision Ledger
rows.contractShape: DecisionSummary: decisionId, receiptRef/hash, action/target summaries, evidenceRefs, policyVersion, model/tool version refs, occurredAt, uncertainty, redactionVersion. Principal filtering precedes projection; no secrets, private chain-of-thought or raw provider prompts.
rows.acceptance: Verify receipt/hash bindings and redaction; record uncertainty; exclude private chain-of-thought

rows.title: Time-travel Debugging
rows.contractShape: ReplayQuery: tenant-derived principal scope, runId, fromSequence/toSequence, limit(1–100), mode=read_only. ReplayView: ordered checkpoint/observation/result refs, recorded usage/timing, unknown outcomes, source digests. Replays recorded results only; never sends an original external operation again.
rows.acceptance: Replay recorded results in read-only/isolated mode; no re-sending emails/payments; scoped access

rows.title: Agent Digital Twin / Simulation
rows.contractShape: SimulationRequest: candidateVersionRef, scenarioSetRef, heldOutVersionRef, fixedBudgetRef, fixtureEnvironmentRef, noLiveEffects=true. SimulationReport: scenario/metric results, governance violations, usage, environmentDigest, input/candidate/eval digests, limitations. Candidate cannot write held-out cases or switch to real accounts.
rows.acceptance: Independent held-out cases, fixed versions/budgets; explicitly separate simulation and live behavior

rows.title: Agent Versioning
rows.contractShape: AgentVersionManifest: versionId, prompt/config/model-policy/skills/tools/permission-policy/memory-policy/eval-set digests, compatibilityVersion, previousVersionRef?, signerRef. AgentVersionValidation: valid/rejected plus verifiedDigest and safe issues. A/B/canary/rollback is separately reviewed; signatures do not establish safety.
rows.acceptance: Reproducible digests, authorized A/B exposure, compatibility checks and rollback; no frozen-golden edits

rows.title: Agent CI/CD
rows.contractShape: AgentReleaseRequest: candidateManifestRef, immutableEvalReportRefs, protectedBaselineDigest, gateVersion, targetEnvironmentRef, promotionApprovalRef. AgentReleaseReport: eligible/denied, independent gate evidence, signatures, canary/rollback plan refs. Evaluation does not itself deploy or promote.
rows.acceptance: Independent protected gates, signed artifacts/evidence, reversible rollout; candidate cannot edit its own gate Define the explicit Node release project and require the named release test to be discovered/executed; no jsdom or empty-suite pass substitutes for protected promotion, signed evidence and canary/rollback qualification.

rows.title: Model Router 2.0
rows.contractShape: ModelRoutingRequest: ModelRequest, taskClass, qualifiedCandidateModelRefs, scoringPolicyVersion, observedMetricRefs. ModelRoutingDecision: selectedModelRef|null, privacyEligibility evidence, scoreBasis, policyDecisionRef, budgetReservationRef, reason. Classify/authorize destination before cost/quality/latency scoring.
rows.acceptance: Privacy eligibility precedes scoring; no forbidden fallback; record selection and observed quality/usage

rows.title: Agent Swarm Mode
rows.contractShape: SwarmRequest: goalRef, planRef, reviewedAllocationRef, agentVersionRefs, requestedDepth≤2, requestedFanOut≤8, sharedBudgetRef. SwarmPlan: chief/lead/worker assignments, dependency refs, reducedGrantRequests, task/deadline limits. Request limits may be lowered by policy; larger background allocations require a distinct reviewed schedule/scope and never unrestricted peer grants.
rows.acceptance: Explicit reviewed depth/fan-out/budget limits and allocation; reduced grants; no unrestricted peer delegation

rows.title: Protected goal-to-artifact V2 workflow
rows.contractShape: Wire the reviewed GoalSpec/TaskPlan/VerificationReport/ProjectRecord ports through existing authenticated GatewayClient and service composition roots; goal/result events use M06 negotiated projections
rows.acceptance: An approved workload with WorkspaceSession.demoMode=false produces an authorized artifact whose digest/provenance and current success criteria verify; a seeded unsupported claim remains unknown/unmet. Interrupt after effect before receipt, restart, reconcile without duplicate execution, cancel/revoke a child, and deny stale publication. All inference uses privacy, signed receipts verify, runtime-role scope isolation holds, and shared spend remains within the approved workload budget. Actual browser UI shows exact approvals, honest progress and verified versus unmet outcomes. Required unavailable infrastructure fails the live gate.
